hero.headline: Websites that sell, book and organise.
hero.lead: Full stack web developer. I design and build complete projects, from the database to the last interaction.

about.title: First I understand what the business needs. Then I write the code.
about.p1: I'm a full stack web developer with a Higher Vocational Diploma in Cross-Platform Application Development. My projects are live and working: an online store with payments and an admin panel, a car dealership site that imports its catalogue automatically, a booking system, an education platform and a corporate website.
about.p2: Talking to people comes naturally to me: I listen, ask questions and turn what a company needs into concrete technical decisions. I adapt quickly to new teams and environments, I work towards clear goals, and every project teaches me something new.

communication.title: Straightforward communication
communication.text: I explain technical things without jargon and ask before assuming.

goals.title: Goal-driven
goals.text: Every feature has to serve a purpose: selling, booking, organising.

fullstack.title: End-to-end view
fullstack.text: Interface, server, database and deployment. I understand the whole project.

learning.title: Always learning
learning.text: Payments, scraping, real time: each project pushed me to master something new.

about.lookingText: A role as a full stack web developer or programmer. I also take on freelance projects.

projects.title: Five live projects. Five different problems.
projects.intro: Every image is a real screenshot of each website. The technologies listed have been checked against the source code.

suplementacion.name: Suplementación Deportiva
suplementacion.summary: Online sports nutrition store covering the full purchase cycle: catalogue, cart, payment and order tracking.
suplementacion.problem: Selling supplements online with a quick way to find, compare and buy, while letting the store manage products and orders on its own.

features.1: Admin panel with products, orders and statistics
features.2: Catalogue with search, filters and sorting
features.5: Deal of the day with countdown
features.7: Technical SEO with sitemap and robots

carboom.name: CarBoom
carboom.summary: Website for a used car dealership in Alicante, with a catalogue fed by its Wallapop listings.
carboom.problem: Avoid keeping stock in two places: cars listed on Wallapop are extracted and shown on the dealership's website.

features.0: Wallapop listing extraction with Puppeteer and Cheerio
features.1: Scheduled catalogue sync with Vercel Cron
features.2: Catalogue with photos, model and price for every car

aulas.name: Aulas
aulas.summary: Virtual classroom to organise groups and subjects, share resources in the cloud and communicate within each class.
aulas.problem: Bring a class's materials and communication together in one place, with different permissions depending on each person's role.

features.3: Roles and permissions within each group
features.4: Chat per group and per subject

aulas.treeNote: Taken from the repository. The platform requires an account, so only the login page is public.

powerfitt.name: Reservas PowerFitt
powerfitt.summary: Appointment booking system for a nutrition and training plan service.
powerfitt.problem: Let clients book an appointment in a few steps, without calls or messages, and let the professional manage the schedule from a dashboard.

features.0: Guided three-step booking: details, date and time, confirmation
features.1: Available time slots updated in real time with Socket.IO

efitec.name: Efitec
efitec.summary: Corporate website for an energy efficiency consultancy in Alicante.
efitec.problem: Present the company's services clearly and make it easy for visitors to get in touch.

features.1: Contact form that sends to the company's inbox
features.2: WhatsApp contact and social media links
features.3: Legal notice, privacy and cookie policies
